blockers.title: rule and bundled distribution license closure is incomplete
blockers.progress_evidence: docs/research/product-source-closure.md and docs/research/data/product-source-closure-linux-qt5.json bind the fixed Linux Qt5 CMake diec to 223 direct objects plus 14 of 36 project archive members, yielding 237 compile sources across 13 components, two root sources, and one 13-component AUTOMOC unit; the byte-identical GNU ld map binds the XArchive, XCapstone, and XSIMD member reports and 14 root licenses; docs/research/linux-cmake-install-tree.md and docs/research/data/linux-cmake-install-tree.json bind the default CMake install to 4916 regular files and 60881050 bytes, prove it installs die/diec/diel plus duplicated db/info/YARA subtrees with only one root LICENSE candidate, and prove a CLI-only build copies a partial tree before failing on the missing GUI binary; docs/research/xucl-origin.md and docs/research/data/xucl-origin.json trace PRODUCT-LICENSE-GAP-001 to the fixed official UCL 1.03 archive with 94.76/89.08 percent combined 12/64-token coverage, GPL-2.0-or-later source headers, exact GPLv2 COPYING/ACC_LICENSE evidence, the omitted ACC copyright/GPL header, and copy_or_translation_approved/legal_review_complete both false; docs/research/rar-decoder-provenance.md and docs/research/data/rar-decoder-origin.json bind the XArchive decoder to a RARLAB official archive declaring UnRAR 7.13, prove all 150 source files byte-identical to the pinned mirror and all 159 files equal after line-ending normalization, preserve exact license/acknowledgments evidence, and keep copy_or_translation_approved/legal_review_complete false; docs/research/runtime-rule-assets-license.md and docs/research/data/runtime-rule-assets-license.json bind all 2268 db/db_extra/db_custom assets; docs/research/runtime-png-provenance.md and docs/research/data/runtime-png-history.json bind all 22 PNGs to two original DosX commits, 20 blobs, C100/R100 history, PNG metadata, origin-time MIT LICENSE, and contribution-policy/sign-off boundaries while keeping legal_review_complete false; docs/research/xarchive-final-link-closure.md and docs/research/data/xarchive-final-link-closure-linux.json prove only LzmaDec.c.o is extracted from 22 built XArchive archive members; docs/research/xcapstone-license-closure.md and docs/research/data/xcapstone-license-closure-linux.json bind distinct MIT, Capstone BSD, and LLVM NCSA texts; docs/research/xsimd-license-closure.md and docs/research/data/xsimd-license-closure-linux.json bind the three-member XSIMD MIT closure while excluding CUDA
blockers.closure_evidence: reviewed rules/runtime/source distribution license and attribution report with no unclassified release inputs

blockers.title: performance baseline, benchmark environment, and resource targets are not frozen
blockers.progress_evidence: docs/research/upstream-performance-baseline.md and docs/research/data/upstream-benchmark-linux-qt5.json establish a pinned five-layer Linux Qt5 warm baseline with 17 warmup and 90 measured direct processes; docs/research/upstream-performance-affinity.md and docs/research/data/upstream-benchmark-linux-qt5-affinity.json add a single WSL2/Linux vCPU run with cpuset.cpus.effective=0 while preserving the short-control partial-RSS boundary; docs/research/upstream-deployment-size.md and docs/research/data/upstream-deployment-size-linux-qt5.json establish ELF, 16-real-file dynamic dependency, and 2268-rule size accounting; docs/research/linux-cmake-install-tree.md and docs/research/data/linux-cmake-install-tree.json add the exact 4916-file/60881050-byte default CMake staging tree while explicitly excluding compressed-package and system-library claims; Rust paired, cold, physical-core/topology repeated sessions, cross-platform package size, reviewed thresholds, and default limits remain open
blockers.closure_evidence: reviewed benchmark identity, baseline report, and measurable latency, memory, size, and resource-limit targets
